_meta.translationStatus: Human educator approval reported by the user, 2026-10-10. All people, shops, handles and payments are fictional.

hook.1: Mina: A phone stand costs ₹180 at Nila Phone Corner. Let's practise the payment first.
hook.2: Shopkeeper: Here's a mock screen. No real money or PIN belongs in this game.
hook.3: Mina: First, what if a request says I must approve a payment to get a refund?

lesson.title: A refund or a payment request?
lesson.prompt: You expect a ₹60 refund from Nila Phone Corner. A merchant collect request arrives with this instruction. What do you do?
lesson.note: Untrusted instruction: ‘Approve with your PIN to receive your refund.’ SAMPLE ONLY
lesson.hint1: A collect request asks you to pay. It is not an incoming refund.
lesson.hint2: You never need a UPI PIN to receive money. Decline this request to pay.
lesson.explanation: A collect request asks you to send money to the requester. Approving a payment with a UPI PIN authorizes money to leave your account; receiving money does not require your PIN. Decline a payment request disguised as a refund. This screen is simulated; never enter a real PIN.

payment.decline: Decline and re-check with the shopkeeper
payment.hint1: Check the displayed recipient name and payment ID before approving.
payment.hint2: If the details differ from the intended recipient, stop and confirm the correct payment ID. A similar name is not enough.

decision.title: Check before paying
decision.prompt: You agreed to buy the phone stand for ₹180. You independently confirmed the shop's details: Nila Phone Corner, nila-corner@demo.invalid. Compare the screen below, then complete this fictional payment if all details match.
decision.explanation: The name, payment ID and ₹180 amount match the details you independently confirmed for your purchase. In this exercise, approve the intended payment using the simulated PIN action. A UPI PIN authorizes paying, not receiving. Never approve an unexpected request just because its name looks familiar.

consequence.explanation: You checked the details and completed the agreed fictional purchase. Any earlier decline paused the exercise, and your corrected choice completed it. No real money moved. Now check a different payee and amount.

leela.title: A different repair counter
leela.prompt: The fictional receipt says Leela Repairs, ₹275. Check the new screen before paying.
leela.explanation: The receipt says Leela Repairs, but the screen says Leela Repair. A similar name does not confirm the recipient. Stop and confirm the correct payment ID before approving.

kavi.title: A different cable purchase
kavi.prompt: The fictional receipt says Kavi Cables, ₹95. Check the new screen before paying.
kavi.explanation: The receipt says Kavi Cables, but the screen says Kavi Cable. Even with the expected amount, a name mismatch needs checking. Confirm the correct payment ID before approving.

declined_payment.review: Your choice: you declined the agreed purchase even though the name, payment ID and amount matched the independently confirmed details. Expected choice in this exercise: approve the fictional payment after checking. Concept: a UPI PIN authorizes paying, not receiving. Why it matters: always declining leaves intended payments unfinished and does not demonstrate recipient checking. If you are unsure in real life, pause and verify rather than pay.

wrong_payee.review: Your choice: you approved a payment whose recipient name did not match the intended shop. Safer choice: decline and confirm the correct payment ID. Concept: verify the recipient before authorizing a payment. Why it matters: a similar name can belong to a different recipient, so money could go to the wrong account. Retry after checking the details.

pin_to_receive.review: Your choice: you followed an instruction to approve with a PIN to receive a refund. Safer choice: decline that payment request. Concept: a UPI PIN authorizes paying; receiving money never requires it. Why it matters: approving the request could send money out instead of bringing a refund in. A corrected safety mistake still caps this attempt at 1 star; replay to practise safely.
